notes.title: Patch notes for version 0.11.0.0
notes.content:
Gameplay:
- Added new field sizes: 7v7 and 6v6.
- Added new stadium: Nippon Stadium.
- Added new balls: Pact Flare and Pact 90 Yellow.

Graphics:
- Improved grass texture.
- Improved 3D grass appearance.
- Slightly improved 3D grass performance.

UI:
- Improved ball selection menu.
- Improved map selection menu.
- Fixed alt tab chat messages bug.

Other:
- Allow server admin to change server password and max players.

notes.title: Patch notes for version 0.10.5.0
notes.content:
Gameplay:
- Introduced AI chat moderation and an option to report player messages.
- Updated the mute system for fairer punishment durations.
- Fixed an issue with players getting stuck on the "Accept Match Completed" status when queuing in matchmaking.

UI:
- Added an icon to indicate when a player has lost connection.
- Fixed a glitch in the Tab Menu.
- Fixed an issue with the kick power bar widget for other players in player-hosted sessions.

Other:
- Fixed the matchmaking server process to improve reliability.
- Added five new items for release in the game store.
- Implemented small optimizations and improvements for overall stability.
- Changed the Maximum Connection Timeout from 80s to 30s to remove disconnected players more quickly.

notes.title: Patch Notes for version 0.10.4.0
notes.content:
Gameplay:
- Added an option to display a directional arrow to assist new players.
- Increased goal size by 5%.
- Increased goalkeeper sliding tackle duration by 15%.
- Increased goalkeeper vertical reach by 5%.
- Goalkeepers can no longer concede a penalty inside the goal area.
- Changed penalty location to be determined by the exact contact point rather than simply checking if the player is overlapping the penalty area.
- Reduced maximum kick power charging time from 510ms to 500ms (-2%).
- Fixed a bug where penalties had priority over free kicks for different teams.
- Fixed an issue where there was insufficient time to take a penalty at the end of overtime.
- Fixed the random weather option.

Graphics:
- Added six new ball options.
- Randomized the initial goalpost model.
- Randomized the initial field pattern.
- Randomized the initial ball texture.
- Randomized the initial weather.
- Removed extreme weather presets, including Thunderstorm, Blizzard, Overcast, Dust, and Dust Storm.

UI:
- Added a link to a preview video for celebration-type items when inspecting them in the store (some celebration videos will be added later).
- Added a new "Assistances" tab under the Game Settings menu.
- Fixed a bug where the matchmaking interface would go blank due to a network error.
- Fixed a bug with permissions in the Public Server Logs interface.

Other:
- Introduced new store items, including unique cosmetics and goal celebration items.
- Updated the in-game Roadmap to reflect upcoming features and improvements for this quarter.

notes.title: Patch notes for version 0.10.3.0
notes.content:
Gameplay:
- Added team balancing to Matchmaking using a new method to ensure fairer matchups.

UI:
- Added a warning prompt when selecting a goalkeeper with fewer than 10 matches played, encouraging a more balanced team composition.
- Updated the matchmaking interface to inform players when the selected region is unavailable.
- Implemented a tooltip on the queue status widget to provide additional context and clarity.
- Removed any residual data from a previously selected region when a new region is picked in matchmaking settings.
- Now displays the currently selected matchmaking region in the party.
- Fixed a bug where the “placement matches” message continued to appear after players completed their required matches.
- Changed party UI to prepare for the upcoming invite friends to party feature.

Audio:
- Fixed an issue where the “acceptance required” sound failed to play if the first match was not accepted and the second match was immediately found thereafter.

Other:
- Updated the in-game Roadmap to reflect the upcoming features and improvements for the next quarter.
- New store items including unique cosmetic and goal celebration items.
- Added hidden features for testing in preparation for matchmaking friend party invite, player report, and more.

notes.title: Patch notes for version 0.10.2.0
notes.content:
Gameplay:
- Resolved an issue where players could receive an incorrect matchmaking ban.
- Fixed a bug causing penalties to occasionally spawn on the wrong side of the field.
- Added an option to deselect a team.

Graphics:
- Optimized crowd fan particle performance, especially on the Vortex map.

UI:
- Added functionality to copy messages from chat history by clicking on them.
- Enhanced various UI elements for a smoother experience.
- Corrected several translation errors.

notes.title: Patch notes for version 0.10.1.0
notes.content:
Gameplay:
- New matchmaking rating system implemented for better balance and fairer matches.
- Placement matches feature added, with rank and history reset to ensure a fresh start for all players.
- Fixed floating wearable item bug when a player is removed from a match.

UI:
- Added information about the current number of matches being played in the matchmaking region when queueing.
- Fixed welcome modal UI error causing incorrect displays.
- Fixed tab menu skill group display not showing correctly.
- Improved translations for multiple languages.

Graphics:
- Fixed halo VFX not appearing correctly in multiplayer matches.

Other:
- Various minor bug fixes and small improvements to performance and stability.

notes.title: Matchmaking and Store!
notes.content:
Patch notes for version 0.10.0.0:

Gameplay:
- Matchmaking system introduced, allowing players to queue up for matches with region-based separation for lower latency and better connections.
- Skill groups added to balance matchmaking by matching players with opponents of similar skill levels.
- Player statistics feature added to track performance and growth across matchmaking matches.
- Fixed the throw-in bug in futsal matches.
- Fixed the mouse sensitivity curve not applying correctly under default settings.

UI:
- In-game store integrated into gameplay, launching with 15 cosmetic items: 8 wearables and 7 goal celebrations. The store includes tabs for 'Featured', 'Currency Packages', and 'Browse.'
- Inventory system added to manage purchased cosmetics directly in-game.
- Roadmap page added to the Main Menu, providing a preview of upcoming features and improvements.
- Server ping display added to the server browser list.
- General UI improvements implemented for better usability.
- Added a warning when the same key is assigned to multiple actions.
- Player skill group rating added to the match statistics menu.
- Dedicated servers are now sorted by latency.

Graphics:
- Fixed resolution bug preventing correct options from appearing for some players.

Audio:
- Fixed interface volume not working when hovering or clicking buttons.

Other:
- Various bug fixes and small improvements to performance and stability.

notes.title: 📢 IT’S TIME! WORLD OF FOOTBALL IS HERE! ⚽🔥
notes.content:
The big day is finally here! We're beyond excited to announce that [b]World of Football is launching into Early Access NOW! 🥳[/b]

[b]Ready to step onto the pitch? 🏟️[/b]
👉 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/946880/World_of_Football/]Play World of Football now on Steam![/url]

🎥 Check out our brand-new launch trailer here:
[previewyoutube=rDSwMgnUXPY;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]A heartfelt thank you to our amazing community—you’ve been with us through every step of this journey, from playtests to feature suggestions, and now, to this incredible milestone. ❤️
[/i]
[h3]What’s Waiting for You in Early Access?[/h3]

⚽ Physics-Based Gameplay: Enjoy realistic, skill-based football where every move counts.
🌐 Global Matchmaking: Compete against players from around the world with our improved matchmaking system.
📈 Player Statistics & Skill Groups: Track your progress and climb the ranks in competitive play.
🛍️ In-Game Store: Customize your player with unique wearables and goal celebrations.
👥 Team Creation: Build your own team, upload custom emblems, jerseys, and rally your fans.
🌦️ Dynamic Environments: Play in stadiums with changing weather and lighting that affect gameplay.
🎯 Advanced Training Tools: Practice your skills with our powerful training editor and custom drills.
🎥 Video Tutorials: Access a library of tutorials to learn game mechanics.
🏆 Community Events: Participate in championships and tournaments hosted by the community.

Thank you for being part of this incredible journey. This is just the beginning. See you on the pitch! 🔥🏟

⚽️ World of Football Team

notes.title: Transitioning to a new model
notes.content:
[i]Hello World of Football community,

First off, we just want to say a huge thank you for all your amazing support and enthusiasm during the playtest. Your feedback and dedication have helped make the game what it is today, and we couldn't have done it without you![/i]

[h2]✨ A NEW CHAPTER BEGINS[/h2]
[i]We're super excited to share that World of Football is evolving! To keep things going strong and to bring you even more awesome features, we're switching from a free-to-play model to a paid game. But don't worry—[b]it will be very affordable, and the price will be localized to be fair for players around the world![/b] This change will allow us to expand our team, ensure the long-term health of the project, and deliver even more content with higher quality.[/i]

[h2]⚽ PLAYTEST CLOSING SOON[/h2]
[i]As we gear up for the game release, [b]the playtest will officially close on November 3rd.[/b] This will give us the chance to execute our strategy to ensure a successful launch.[/i]

[h2]🫂 A TOKEN OF OUR APPRECIATION[/h2]
[i]To show just how much we appreciate you, [b]we're giving 1000 WOF Coins to everyone who logs in between now and the end of the playtest.[/b] To purchase this amount of coins in the in-game store, [b]it would cost roughly the same as the game's price.[/b] It's our way of saying thanks for being such an important part of this journey. Remember to tell your friends to log in too! All they need to do is open the game's main menu to claim their bonus.[/i]

[h2]🔥 WHAT'S COMING FOR EARLY ACCESS?[/h2]
[i]We're excited to let you know that several new features will be available for the Early Access launch that weren't in the playtest. A new roadmap will soon be shared with you as well. Here's what you can look forward to on release day:[/i]
[list]
[i][*] Globally available matchmaking
[*] Increased server availability
[*] In-game store with wearables and goal celebrations
[*] Player statistics for matchmaking
[*] Skill groups[/i]
[/list]

Stay tuned for more updates, including the [b]official release date,[/b] which will be announced soon.

Thanks again for being an amazing part of this community. Together, we'll make World of Football the best it can be!

See you on the pitch!

[b]- The World of Football Team[/b]

notes.title: Official Publisher Announcement!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce that World of Football is officially partnering with indie.io!

For those of you who may not know, having a game publisher like indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From helping manage store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and even helping the game shine at both digital and live events, publishers help in all the aspects that indie developers often struggle with.

We are pleased to announce that tomorrow (June 7th) we will release the first update of this partnership, the Teams feature, which will allow players to create and customize their own teams. This is just one of the first updates that will be coming in the following weeks. We plan to release many exciting updates in collaboration with indie.io.

This collaboration will help elevate World of Football to new heights and provide a better experience for our players. This collaboration will also be instrumental in launching the game in the coming months. Your continued support and involvement from our amazing community are more essential now than ever. Stay tuned for more updates and see you on the pitch!
